text:
deploy-bot: :warning: MANUAL PIN applied by sasha: runtime v4.0 pinned for model=quant-llama3 in eu-west-1 due to OOMs during nightly longseq job. Pin window: 8h. Reason: memory spike in attention kernel after SDK 3.0.0 rollout. https://ops/incident/1699001234

sasha: saw repeated OOM traces at 01:10 UTC, nodes hit OOM-kill, restarted. Rolling back traffic to runtime v3.9 is safest until we patch.

tom: confirmed. logs show a new allocation pattern from sdk 3.0.0 that increases KV cache reserved pages for quant models. repro: `scripts/repro_longseq.sh --model quant-llama3 --seq 512` reproduces OOM within ~2m on 40GB.

irene: can we evict large-prefix requests or force smaller batch sizes as temporary mitigation? also can we move affected model group to dedicated pool with bigger instances?

sasha: mitigation orders: 1) pin runtime v4.0 in eu-west-1 (done), 2) add route to runtime v3.9 for model group quant-llama3, 3) schedule hotfix rolling patch for SDK to limit cache reservation for quant kernels.

ops-bot: Helpful commands:

```
/deploy pin runtime v4.0 --model quant-llama3 --region eu-west-1 --by sasha --reason "OOMs in nightly longseq"
/deploy route add --from runtime:v4.0 --to runtime:v3.9 --region eu-west-1 --match model=quant-llama3
/deploy allocate dedicated-pool --region eu-west-1 --flavor gpu-rt-xl --count 2 --labels team=dedicated-evac
```

tom: i've paused the SDK canary and marked the SDK ticket: https://git/repo/issues/9987. i'll try a minimal patch that caps kv-reserve at 1.2x for quant kernels.

irene: i'll prepare the soft-unpin runbook and timeline. propose: patch -> unit/regression -> soft-unpin window at 04:00 UTC (low traffic) -> 10m gate checks at each ramp (5%, 25%, 100%). if any OOM or p95>baseline+40% -> immediate rollback to v3.9.

sasha: add monitoring alert: if node OOM count > 1 in 5m OR container restarts > 3 in 10m, trigger auto rollback and page eng-oncall.

ops-bot: Note: pin is currently active until 1699033034 (8h). To extend or lift pin, use `/deploy pin extend` or `/deploy unpin` with eng-releases approval.

tom: quick smoke on a spare node after adding route succeeded. no OOMs for 30m, longseq qps steady.

irene: drafting release note: "Temporary pin of runtime v4.0 in eu-west-1 for quant-llama3 due to OOMs with SDK 3.0.0; traffic routed to v3.9 while SDK patch is prepared. Customer impact: transient increased latencies for large-sequence requests in EU; no data loss." will post to #incidents and #release-notes-staging.

sasha: thanks. follow-ups: (A) SDK patch PR and canary revert plan, (B) validation matrix for longseq+kvcache, (C) dedicated pool allocation if repeated. I'll hand off soft-unpin ops to irene once patch merges.

ops-bot: closing note: this thread will remain updated. please add gate numbers and link to PRs in replies. :lock:
